candidate_state: release preparation from the verified v0.4.5 source commit

nnue_release_asset.qualification: Recorded material-only 1T gate PASS on engine 06490fc; no current-v0.4.5 4T qualification or default-adoption decision.

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only native USI smoke; nn_r6 is separately distributed as an explicit experimental opt-in asset
internal_measurement.results: The default evaluator and ordinary search policy are unchanged. nn_r6 is verified to load with FV_SCALE=24, but this release does not treat its older one-thread gate as a v0.4.5 or four-thread strength decision.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.5.

known_limitations: nn_r6 is optional and experimental; it is not selected by default.
nn_r6 has no current-v0.4.5 four-thread qualification, external comparison, or WebAssembly/mobile-quality result.
New search and Lazy SMP policies without an independent H1 remain disabled by default.
The qualified PGO throughput results apply only to their recorded Apple M4 configurations; ordinary release builds do not embed those profiles.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
